caption: The drawing features a single object rendered in shades of gray on a plain off-white background. The object is a three-legged metal structure with a circular loop at the top, supported by a sturdy, angled leg extending backwards and two curved legs in the front. The legs end in flat, widened feet. The loop at the top has a hollow center, and there are circular and linear engravings on the front face of the leg support. The drawing is devoid of any other elements or background details, and the object is centered on the page. The artist's signature appears in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
